term:
by
  have h : ∀ (u : Tree) (acc : List Nat), treeAcc (mirror u) acc = (flatten u).reverse ++ acc := by
    intro u acc
    induction u with
    | leaf x => simp [treeAcc, mirror, flatten]
    | fork l r ihl ihr =>
        simp [treeAcc, mirror, flatten, ihl, ihr, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc]
  exact h t []
